title: BITS Pilani at SemEval-2026 Task 9: Structured Supervised Fine-Tuning with DPO Refinement for Polarization Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's ability to detect political polarization and hostility in a curated dataset of political statements by performing binary classification and generating structured rationales that identify manifestations like stereotypes, vilification, and extreme language.
Detecting multicultural polarization, division, and hostility in multilingual online discourse, specifically concerning topics like migration debates and armed conflicts.
Classifying polarized characteristics, stereotypes, and hostility in online social media discourse surrounding gender-related issues.
